tw-wi-kenosha-hanks-ropemaker-1895.st: At the final hearing in Nov 1896 the administrator testified he had received $243.38 in all; no hidden money was reported found.
src: Kenosha County probate, Rudolph Hanks estate, final hearing 4 Nov 1896 (Ancestry WI Wills and Probate)

tw-mi-galien-swem-pot-of-gold-1896.t: The 1900 census lists D. W. Swern as a Galien village merchant; the farm on the 1887 plat belonged to William Swern (b. 1835), so the dig was most likely on the family farm rather than a holding of D. W.'s own.
